metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: This iconic teen comedy shares the sharp wit, memorable quotes, and high school hierarchy dynamics found in 'Clueless' and '10 Things I Hate About You'.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A charming and clever modern teen comedy that, like '10 Things I Hate About You', is inspired by classic literature (The Scarlet Letter) and features a stellar, charismatic lead performance.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: An incredibly fun, lighthearted Shakespeare adaptation (Twelfth Night) that perfectly captures the hilarious, energetic rom-com energy of '10 Things I Hate About You'.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: A highly uplifting, stylish, and empowering comedy with a bubbly aesthetic that matches the stylishness and feel-good vibes of 'Clueless'.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black, this highly witty, fast-paced buddy detective comedy shares the exact same DNA, sharp-tongued banter, and crime-comedy style as 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: An action-comedy masterpiece with incredibly tight editing and hilarious banter, perfect for fans of buddy-cop dynamics like 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A brilliantly paced mystery-comedy with great ensemble chemistry, offering the same suspenseful fun and laugh-out-loud moments as 'Wake Up Dead Man'.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: As the predecessor to 'Wake Up Dead Man', this star-studded, witty whodunnit is a masterclass in cozy mystery, sharp comedy, and fun twists.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: A direct companion to 'Wake Up Dead Man', this sequel delivers a colorful, high-society mystery filled with eccentric characters and clever humor.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A delightfully breezy, star-studded heist comedy about blue-collar brothers that captures the cool, light crime energy of 'Get Shorty' and 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical, romantic, and highly adventurous fantasy film that beautifully captures the magical wonder of 'Fantastic Beasts' and the lighthearted romance of 'Practical Magic'.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: The ultimate action-adventure comfort movie, featuring a perfect blend of high stakes, fantasy elements, and hilarious comedic timing like 'Dungeons & Dragons'.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A highly creative, feel-good action adventure set inside a video game, making it an ideal watch for fans of the modern 'Jumanji' movies.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A hidden gem of a monster-pocalypse adventure that balances heartfelt humor, imaginative creature designs, and exciting survival action like 'Jumanji'.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: The gold standard of fantasy adventure comedies, matching the witty, self-aware charm and delightful questing vibes of 'Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves'.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A space-opera adventure filled with a lovable band of misfits, hilarious banter, and an incredible soundtrack, sharing the exact same energetic tone as 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A stylized, high-octane action comedy filled with colorful, quirky characters, perfect for those who enjoyed the fast-paced, irreverent tone of 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A visually spectacular, video-game-inspired romantic comedy that matches the kinetic pacing and whimsical energy of 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl'.

metas.name: Borat: Cultural Learnings of America for Make Benefit Glorious Nation of Kazakhstan
metas.description: Sacha Baron Cohen's iconic mockumentary masterpiece that delivers the same shocking, hilarious, and boundary-pushing satire as 'Brüno'.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: A hilarious, star-studded satire of Hollywood that matches the bold, outrageous, and unhinged comedic sensibilities of 'Brüno'.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever, sci-fi romantic comedy with a time-loop twist, offering a highly entertaining, modern, and laugh-out-loud experience.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful, self-aware fairy tale parody that blends live-action romance with magical fantasy, perfect for fans of 'Practical Magic' and 'Clueless'.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A colorful, chaotic, and heartwarming animated comedy with a frantic, inventive visual style that fans of 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl' will love.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: A stunning, highly energetic animated adventure that perfectly blends light comedy, high stakes, and revolutionary visuals.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A highly fun, self-aware horror-comedy with great group chemistry, matching the campy monster-survival vibes of 'Anaconda' but with much sharper humor.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: Featuring Heath Ledger (from '10 Things I Hate About You'), this fun, anachronistic medieval adventure combines great music, comedy, and a lighthearted story.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: The quintessential horror-comedy that perfectly balances genuine stakes with laugh-out-loud buddy comedy, great for fans of 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie with the heart of 'Big' and the humor of a classic family comedy, matching the lighthearted, crowd-pleasing action of the 'Jumanji' reboots.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A colorful, energetic, and highly quotable teen comedy that fits perfectly alongside 'Clueless' and '10 Things I Hate About You'.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A highly comforting, hilarious, and music-filled comedy with a lovable cast of underdogs, perfect for easy, feel-good viewing.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: An iconic showcase of Jim Carrey's physical comedy and cartoonish energy, making it a perfect double-feature companion to 'Ace Ventura: Pet Detective'.

metas.name: Liar Liar
metas.description: Another classic high-energy Jim Carrey comedy that delivers non-stop laughs through a high-concept premise, matching the frantic pacing of 'Ace Ventura'.

metas.name: Snatch
metas.description: A highly stylistic, fast-paced British crime comedy with snappy dialogue and quirky characters, ideal for fans of 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: An incredibly fun jungle-adventure romantic comedy that recaptures the playful action-adventure tone of 'Jumanji' and 'The Mummy'.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A brilliant action-comedy that subverts espionage tropes with hilarious physical comedy and sharp dialogue, appealing to fans of 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: National Treasure
metas.description: A highly entertaining, lighthearted history mystery adventure that offers pure, unpretentious fun in the vein of 'Fantastic Beasts'.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: A visually spectacular, glamorous, and highly heartwarming modern romantic comedy that captures the lavish charm and humor of 'Clueless'.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: Co-directed by Taika Waititi (director of 'Thor: Ragnarok'), this vampire mockumentary is endlessly clever, dryly hilarious, and incredibly unique.

metas.name: Grosse Pointe Blank
metas.description: A sharp, witty 90s comedy about a hitman attending his high school reunion, perfectly blending crime elements with rom-com charm like 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A brilliant, affectionate sci-fi comedy about washed-up actors forced to save real aliens, matching the meta-humor and fun sci-fi adventure of 'Thor: Ragnarok'.
